name: Tradie Ute
summary: The owner's dual-cab Mitsubishi Triton (MQ) as a roster car (R123), rebuilt against the owner's photos after the 2026-10-11 review (br-bwju.8): the black flat-top canopy on a flat tray with checker-plate under-tray boxes, the platform roof rack with a wind deflector and a rolled awning on the left, the chrome "dynamic shield" grille with swept headlights on a tall blunt nose, a solid black bull bar (light bar, fog lamps, winch hook), the snorkel on the driver's A-pillar, a small lift, black wheels with a silver lip, plain paint. Rear drive, 1900 kg: heavier and torquier than the Cruz, lower top speed.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: The compare below is LOD0 against the owner's Triton mesh in four views. "The reference sheet itself" opens LOD0's side against the owner's side photo: a hand-traced outline of Screenshot_20240415_085850, IoU 0.717 (docs/evidence/br-bwju.8/reference-photo/score.json; the photo itself stays private: number plate and house). Left to right per view: the reference silhouette, the model's, and the diff (green is model outside the reference, red is reference the model misses), bounding-box normalised. The model is a caricature, wider and lower than the real car, and the photo has perspective, so these IoUs measure a likeness, not a scan. Front and rear three-quarter views are in the turntable.
